extraction_scope: Mechanism claims restricted to source-supported assay observations; generic introductory mechanism text and primer/nucleic-acid mentions were removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SmAPα1-21, SmAPα10-21, and SmAPγ27-44 permeabilized F. graminearum conidial membranes in the propidium iodide uptake assay at MIC exposure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: PI uptake supports membrane damage/permeabilization but does not by itself identify a molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SmAPα1-21 caused conidial outer wall/ultrastructure changes, including a scalloped cell appearance and cytoplasmic disorganization in TEM observations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM supports a cell-wall-associated phenotype but the exact wall component or enzyme target remains unresolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SmAPγ27-44 produced membrane permeabilization and TEM signs of cellular deterioration, including cortical cytoplasm separation from the cell wall.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames this as a different probable mechanism from the α-core wall phenotype; no precise molecular target is proven.
